notes: Map follows the 2026-11-21 regenerated manifest (8 sections, 42 blocks). The cached ncert-science-10 book is the current NCERT edition: chapter 12 is 13 pages carrying only titled sections 12.1-12.4 (domestic electric circuits is 12.4) plus the 'Magnetism in medicine' box. NCERT's rationalisation removed the old-edition sections 12.4 electric motor, 12.5 electromagnetic induction and 12.6 electric generator, and the 12.2.4 solenoid subsection, so no section of this manifest can honestly carry them. sec-01/02 are 12.1 (link between electricity and magnetism, field and field lines); sec-03/04/05 are 12.2-12.2.3 (straight conductor, right-hand thumb rule, circular loop); sec-06 is 12.3; sec-07 is 12.4 domestic electric circuits; sec-08 is the medicine box, whose claim 'an electric current always produces a magnetic field' is exactly the magnetic-field-due-to-current idea. The curated concepts electromagnetic-induction and electric-generator (syllabus section refs 12.5/12.6 are old-edition numbering) still own no block: A2 reports two fatal concept.orphan findings and the assessment bank stays blocked until either a regeneration grounded in sources that carry those sections or a recorded syllabus re-curation. Every block is mapped by its section id; A2 fails on any unmapped section or orphan concept.
